commands.name: new-tests-present
commands.run: for t in test_frozen_diff_excludes_base_advancement test_changed_file_set_lists_both_sides_of_a_rename test_base_tip_readable_from_snapshot_after_owned_ref_is_gone test_pinned_run_ref_survives_prune test_out_of_diff_read_form_is_tree_scoped test_final_gate_documents_carry_stale_base_guards test_development_review_documents_carry_stale_base_guards; do grep -q "def $t(" claude/skills/co-review/scripts/tests/test_review.py || exit 1; done

commands.name: adapter-flow-tests-present
commands.run: for t in test_approve_path_deletes_the_run_ref test_run_ref_removal_failure_invalidates_after_cleanup; do grep -q "def $t(" claude/skills/co-review/scripts/tests/test_adapter_flow.py || exit 1; done

commands.name: policy-emits-changed-file-rules
commands.run: f=$(mktemp) && uv run --no-project --offline --no-cache python claude/skills/co-review/scripts/gate_report.py policy --section POLICY >"$f" && for p in three-dot 'changed-file set' '--no-renames' 'stale-base artifact' 'git show <base_tip>:<path>' 'affected caller'; do grep -qF -- "$p" "$f" || { rm -f "$f"; exit 1; }; done && ! grep -qF 'git diff origin/main' "$f"; rc=$?; rm -f "$f"; exit $rc

commands.name: claude-co-review-adapter-steps
commands.run: f=claude/skills/co-review/SKILL.md; for p in 'diff --name-only --no-renames' 'headRefOid,changedFiles,files' resolve-base base-context.json refs/co-review-run/ 'update-ref -d' 'stale-base artifact'; do grep -qF -- "$p" "$f" || exit 1; done

commands.name: codex-co-review-adapter-steps
commands.run: f=codex/skills/co-review/SKILL.md; for p in 'diff --name-only --no-renames' 'headRefOid,changedFiles,files' resolve-base base-context.json refs/co-review-run/ 'update-ref -d' 'stale-base artifact'; do grep -qF -- "$p" "$f" || exit 1; done

commands.name: review-change-skills-carry-guards
commands.run: for f in claude/skills/review-change/SKILL.md codex/skills/review-change/SKILL.md; do for p in '--no-renames' 'ls-files --others' REVIEW_BASE_REF base-context.json 'changed-file set' 'stale-base artifact'; do grep -qF -- "$p" "$f" || exit 1; done; done

commands.name: operating-principles-standing-rule
commands.run: for p in three-dot 'changed-file set' 'stale-base artifact' discard 'git show'; do grep -qF -- "$p" claude/operating-principles.md || exit 1; done

commands.name: no-two-dot-instruction
commands.run: ! grep -rn 'git diff origin/main' claude/skills codex/skills claude/operating-principles.md claude/rules/personal

commands.name: herdr-core-untouched
commands.run: git diff --quiet "$(git merge-base HEAD origin/main)" -- claude/hooks/herdr_orch_core.py
